name: io.swellwise/forecast
title: Swellwise
description: Surf forecasts for Portugal: swell, wind and tides for hand-reviewed beaches, hourly.

tools.name: search_surf_spots
tools.description: Search published Portuguese surf spots in Swellwise by free-text query or region slug. Returns spot slugs, names, regions, coordinates, break types, beach orientation, and calibration status.

query.description: Free-text search (accent-insensitive) across spot name, beach, municipality, or region.

region.description: Region slug filter: 'norte', 'centro', 'lisboa', 'alentejo' or 'algarve'. English names (e.g. 'lisbon', 'north') are accepted.

limit.description: Maximum number of spots to return (default 10, max 25).

tools.name: get_spot_forecast
tools.description: Get compact marine, wind, and surf quality forecast for a published surf spot slug. Defaults to 3 days at a 3-hour step (max 8 days at 3-hour step, or max 3 days at 1-hour step). Always includes offshore modelling disclaimer and calibration status.

spot.description: Published surf spot slug (e.g. 'milfontes', 'carcavelos'). Use search_surf_spots to discover slugs.

days.description: Number of forecast days to return (default 3, max 8 with stepHours=3, max 3 with stepHours=1).

stepHours.description: Hour step for forecast rows: 3 (default, allows up to 8 days) or 1 (capped at 3 days).

tools.name: get_spot_tides
tools.description: Get astronomical tide predictions on Zero Hidrográfico (ZH) for a published surf spot slug. Returns 30-minute heights and high/low extremes with datum, limitations, and FES2022 attribution.

spot.description: Published surf spot slug (e.g. 'milfontes', 'carcavelos'). Use search_surf_spots to discover slugs.

date.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD (Europe/Lisbon). Defaults to today in Europe/Lisbon.

days.description: Number of days to predict (1 to 7, default 3).
